dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature transitioning from the posterior dorsal ridge to a sharp posterior-pointing apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, pointed shape with a minimal pixel radius at the peak morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, approximately 55-degree angular ascent relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, medium-radius convex curve forming the dorsal-anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with significant thickness at the base, narrowing toward the distal tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon descent and the rostrum horizontal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cyan/teal chromatic luminescence with high-intensity specular highlights and mottled light patterns on the mid-lateral body surface.
